_comment: The baseline WER ledger for egs/yesno/asr.
reference_wer is the number in egs/yesno/asr/README.md, measured by the
author on CUDA with torch 2.1 and sclite. The recipe tier runs on CPU
with a newer torch, so the two are not expected to agree exactly, and
max_wer is the gate: a run above it fails, a run below it does not.
The gate is deliberately loose to begin with. test_yesno has 232
reference words, so one word error is 0.43%, and a 1.5% allowance is
about three word errors. Tighten these once several real runs have been
recorded; a gate nobody has seen pass is not yet a baseline.
Judge a change against reference_wer and tighten max_wer deliberately.
Raising max_wer to make a run pass is how a ledger stops meaning
